worldcombat.skill.strength.summary: A straight punch with the whole body behind it: a clean, never-missing line with no side effects that shoves the target; if it cannot give ground, the blow adds a wall slam.
worldcombat.skill.strength.description.0: The punch deals %1$s contact damage, reaching %2$s blocks with a %3$s block punch radius.
worldcombat.skill.strength.description.1: A hit shoves the target %1$s blocks along the punch; when it can barely move (a wall or obstacle behind it), a further %2$s wall-slam strike lands.
worldcombat.skill.strength.plant.on: Planted form: a heavier punch (more power, further shove, harder wall slam), but a longer wind-up, recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.strength.plant.off: Driving form: faster to throw and quicker to recycle, at the cost of a lighter single blow and a smaller wall-slam bonus.
worldcombat.skill.strength.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.strength.growth.0: From level %1$s the punch power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.strength.growth.1: From level %1$s the punch power rises to %2$s and the wall slam to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.strength.use.0: A steady heavy blow at point-blank range
worldcombat.skill.strength.use.1: Punch a target into a wall or obstacle for a bonus wall slam
worldcombat.skill.strength.use.2: No side effects, so it is always available
worldcombat.skill.strength.preference.pl: On: a heavier punch, a further shove and a harder wall slam, but a longer wind-up, recovery and cooldown. Off: the driving form is faster to throw and recycle, at the cost of a lighter blow and a smaller wall-slam bonus.
worldcombat.skill.strength.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger starts punches sooner, and is easier to kite while travelling.
